title: Book a MenB vaccination appointment
description: Book, change or cancel a MenB vaccination appointment online.
text:
# Book a MenB vaccination appointment

You can use this service if you're 17 to 18 years old and born between 1 September 2007 and 31 August 2008. You must be registered with a GP surgery in England.

Find out how to register with a GP surgery if you are not registered.

You can find UK wide MenB vaccination services in Wales , Northern Ireland and Scotland .

The MenB vaccine is given in 2 doses, which need to be at least 4 weeks apart. Book your 2nd dose after you've had your 1st dose.

## How it works

Use this service to:

- book an appointment for your 1st or 2nd dose

- check your existing appointment details

- change an appointment

- cancel an appointment

## Find a pharmacy

You can find a pharmacy that offers MenB vaccinations for young people if you were born on or after 21 July 2001, and for the first time this autumn you are:

- starting university

- starting at some further education colleges as a residential student

International students and students from Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, the Channel Islands, the Isle of Man and those who are travelling abroad to study are also eligible.

You'll need to bring evidence of your university or college offer.

You do not need to be registered with a GP to get a MenB vaccine at a pharmacy.

## Book over the phone

You can call 119 free of charge to book over the phone if you cannot book online. You can speak to a translator if you need to.
